extracted.name: Sue's Hot Fudge Sauce
extracted.description: Decadent thick and delicious hot fudge sauce. Simple to make and so much better than store-bought!
instruction_lines: Combine butter, cocoa, sugar and evaporated milk in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil and boil for 7 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Carefully pour hot mixture into a blender and blend for 2 to 4 minutes. Serve immediately. Store in refrigerator.
